comparison.objective: Brake a coasting flywheel before removing its hub nut, not set and lock an adjustment.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a brake and then loosen/remove a nut; detailed tool mechanics are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Flywheel must be stopped with the brake before nut removal; no full rubric was indexed.
comparison.reason: A shared nut is superficial: this tests safe de-energization before disassembly, not counterholding a setting during tightening.
